scope: Real browser, real Amazon Bedrock Nova Lite interpretation, isolated PostgreSQL and private FetchSandbox provider twins. No live CRM or real email delivery.

checks.name: Sign-in navigation generates no background route prefetch burst for either member

Invited browser enrolls configured record, explicitly grants/revokes/restores agent access, denies stale restoration and reloads saved owner; no actions or workflow created; 390px layout has no overflow
Typed natural-language request calls the real model, asks for the missing customer and saves an exact plan without effects
Repeated typed intent and reviewed-plan creation reuse the same saved plan and run without authorizing execution
Two independent named approvals, actual CRM/email HTTP effects and UI verification receipt complete the normal rehearsal
Lost CRM response holds email; killing/restarting the real app preserves the run and read-back recovers without a second CRM write
Customer data changed after approval: the atomic version check rejects the stale write and no downstream message executes
Unsupported extra actions stop in chat without creating a plan or workflow
390px mobile conversation has no horizontal overflow
Typed request automatically assigns single-action assistants; plan replay has no effects and separate-person approval completes in a real background worker with both browsers away
Real app and worker restart automatically read back a lost CRM response, dispatch only the held email, and save a full verification receipt without another CRM write
Managed approval cards, connection setup and saved verification receipt remain readable at 390px without overflow
Typed chat and invited UI transfer one saved run to Temporal without granting approval; second-member approvals complete exactly two effects and reload preserves ownership

Typed real-model chat selects two enrolled records, uses explicitly granted agents, saves held exact actions idempotently and refuses recipient retargeting/self-approval; no effects before independent approval

Confirmed packaged worker SIGKILL and real app restart preserve both scoped UI runs; independent approvals yield exactly four intended effects, actual lost CRM response reconciles without resend, histories replay and reload/mobile preserve exact recipients

Real typed scoped chat with exhausted registered-agent allowance retains a guided Submission incomplete view after refusal/reload; no submitted actions, Temporal ownership, verification receipt or new effects; 390px layout stays readable
